jobs.title: Manager, Operations Strategy (Data and AI Governance)
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Operations team at Airwallex sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and customer experience. The Operations Strategy function drives process optimization, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional program delivery across Airwallex's global operations. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Legal, Security, and Data teams to solve complex problems at scale, ensuring that our operational infrastructure keeps pace with Airwallex's rapid growth. This is a team where you will have direct exposure to senior leadership, work on high-impact programs that shape how the company manages risk and data, and grow through ownership of ambiguous, cross-domain challenges.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

This role sits within the Operations Strategy team and is focused on driving our Data and AI Governance Program, a critical cross-functional initiative.

You will work at the intersection of program management and operations strategy, facilitating working groups across IT, Security, Engineering, Legal, and Data teams to design and operationalize data and AI governance frameworks that reduce data access and use risks while supporting business operations. This work requires someone who can run sprints, align stakeholders across domains, apply critical thinking to access control models and data classification frameworks, and measure success for the workstream. 



This role is based in San Francisco, CA.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own end-to-end program management for cross-functional data and AI governance initiatives: run sprints, track progress, and report to the steering committee via weekly updates and monthly calls.

 - Map dependencies across domains and align stakeholders on data and AI governance strategy, priorities, and sequencing.

 - Set the strategy for which data and AI governance frameworks get implemented, and assess whether they are proportionate to the risk they address.

 - Define and track success metrics for the data and AI governance programs.

 - Translate data and AI governance requirements into operational processes that reduce data access risk without blocking the business, including spearheading access management, review, and technical hardening processes.

 - Run technical deep dives on access control implementation across existing systems like Okta, Databricks, and back office tools, and set the standard new systems must meet.

 - Drive requirements and design documents through development, review, and approval by technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Create a living AI model and use case inventory to enable us to track AI legal and governance risks.

 - Partner with Legal to translate regulatory requirements into actionable policy and process.
   
    


WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

 


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 5+ years of experience, preferably with a fast-growing tech startup, top-tier strategy/management consulting, or equivalent.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are essential.

 - Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, especially with Engineering and Legal teams.

 - Experience with data governance initiatives, including data tagging, classification, and ownership.

 - Experience with access management: (1) coordinating cross-functional delivery of access management initiatives, and (2) reviewing access to sensitive data, identifying risks, and driving remediations.

 - Demonstrated ability to run programs end-to-end: sprint facilitation, dependency mapping, progress reporting, and driving cross-functional alignment.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and communicate it simply and effectively to both technical and executive audiences.

 - Self-starter who can identify and prioritize opportunities to focus on.

 - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
   
    


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience interpreting and operationalizing requirements from regulators in a financial services or payments environment.

 - Experience with AI governance best practices and frameworks.

 - Experience operationalizing privacy and AI regulations into actionable requirements and associated certifications (e.g., CIPP/AIGP).

 - Familiarity with identity and access management tools (e.g., Okta) and modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks).

 - Technology, Financial Services, and/or experience in a high-growth environment is advantageous.

 - Comfort operating in environments with high standards, fast iteration cycles, and evolving priorities.

 - Curiosity to learn quickly, adapt fast, and grow through stretch opportunities.

About the team

The Regulatory & Compliance team helps Airwallex grow responsibly as a global financial platform. Operating within the Strategy & Operations Office of Regulatory & Compliance, we serve as the central strategic engine driving group-wide transformation, regulatory growth, and operational scaling. We work at the intersection of business strategy, regulatory requirements, technology, and execution. It’s a team for structured, highly analytical, and commercially minded problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex, high-stakes challenges in a fast-moving, hyper-growth environment.


What you’ll do

This is a high-visibility, group-wide role within the Regulatory & Compliance Strategy & Operations Office, responsible for shaping and executing Airwallex’s strategic priorities globally. Reporting to the Head of Strategy & Operations (Regulatory & Compliance), you will own and drive critical strategic initiatives—from global market expansion and operating model redesigns to cutting-edge AI and automation initiatives across compliance workflows.

As an ex-strategy consultant, you will bring rigorous problem-solving, structured frameworks, and executive-level stakeholder management to bridge the gap between high-level regulatory strategy and operational execution. You will partner closely with Global Leadership, Product, Engineering, Risk, and Regional Operations to ensure our regulatory infrastructure scales efficiently alongside our business expansion.



This role is based in Singapore.


Responsibilities:

 - Strategic Project Leadership: Own and drive end-to-end execution of group-wide strategic projects, including new market expansion strategies, global regulatory licensing roadmaps, and cross-functional operating model redesigns.

 - Compliance Transformation & Automation: Partner with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to identify, architect, and deploy AI-driven tools, automation workflows, and scalable tech infrastructure across regulatory and compliance operations.

 - Operating Model & Strategy Architecture: Diagnose operational bottlenecks and design modern, scalable 1LOD/2LOD interaction models, governance structures, and global compliance frameworks.

 - Executive & Group-Wide Alignment: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership, preparing board-level presentations, strategic business cases, and quantitative decision frameworks for the Chief Regulatory & Compliance Officer and Global Executive Team.

 - Cross-Functional Execution: Mobilize matrixed project teams across Legal, Compliance, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Operations to deliver high-priority strategic mandates on time and within budget.

 - Performance & Metrics Governance: Define, track, and optimize key strategic metrics, operational efficiency benchmarks, and ROI on major compliance transformation investments.
   

Who you are

You have a 'founder's mentality'—you are equally comfortable debating high-level strategy with the C-suite as you are rolling up your sleeves to build a new process from scratch.

Minimum qualifications:

 - 6–8+ years of total professional experience, with a minimum of 4+ years at a top-tier strategy consulting firm.

 - Demonstrated experience delivering strategic projects within financial services, global payments, fintech, or technology platforms.

 - Exceptional problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to structure ambiguous strategic questions into clear hypotheses, analytical frameworks, and operational roadmaps.

 - Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities, with a track record of translating complex data into actionable executive insights.

 - Superior communication, storytelling, and executive presence, with experience influencing C-suite stakeholders and matrixed global teams.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Advanced degree (e.g., MBA or Master’s in Finance, Economics, or Business).

You will operate across strategy and execution: helping frame problems, drive alignment, and ensure complex initiatives move from idea to outcome.

Projects may include:

 - International expansion and market entry strategy

 - Regulatory and banking infrastructure initiatives

 - Organisational effectiveness and operating model design

 - Commercial acceleration and go-to-market execution

 - M&A evaluation and post-merger integration

 - AI-enabled operational transformation

You are someone who:

 - Learns quickly and enjoys steep learning curves

 - Communicates clearly and concisely

 - Can balance detail orientation with speed

 - Is comfortable with high expectations and high ownership

 - Enjoys building rather than observing

 - Exceptional problem-solving and structured thinking abilities

 - Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex topics clearly and concisely

 - Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments with high ownership and accountability

 - Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across seniority levels and functions

 - High degree of commercial judgment and operational pragmatism

 - Experience working directly with senior executives or founders

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of finance, product, and technology. You will be the primary finance partner for Product, Engineering, and Treasury teams, ensuring that every new product launch, fund flow design, and revenue model is built on a sound accounting and controls foundation from day one. At the same time, you will lead the transformation of reconciliation operations through AI and automation, moving the team from largely manual processes toward scalable, technology-first financial operations.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Drive AI adoption and automation in reconciliation: Lead the implementation of AI-based reconciliation tools and automated workflows across cash, intercompany, AR, and treasury operations.

 - Product accounting ownership: Serve as the primary accounting authority for all product-related fund flows, payment clearing, issuing revenue, acquiring settlements, rebate netting, FX revaluation and intercompany rebalancing. Ensure accounting treatment is documented, reviewed, and consistently applied across entities.

 - Fee governance and revenue integrity: Own the accounting treatment sign-off process for all new fee types and revenue models. Design and maintain a structured governance framework (with audit trail) for accounting decisions on commercial arrangements, ensuring alignment with US GAAP group standards and local requirements.

 - Reconciliation operations leadership: Lead the reconciliation and financial operations team, ensuring bank statement access, break resolution, and close-related recon tasks are executed accurately and on time. Drive the team toward T+3 close standards and measurable reduction in open breaks.

 - Financial Risk Monitoring: Provide monitoring metric for financial risk committee on AR balances and credit risk exposures.

 - Cost Engine Build-Up: Lead the design and build-out of a scalable cost engine to support cost accruals and reconciliation. Define cost drivers, allocation logic, data sources, and calculation methodologies in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.

 - FR and MR Topline Reconciliation Own the reconciliation and continuous improvement of Financial Reporting and Management Reporting topline figures, ensuring consistency between the two outputs, including driving initiatives to bridge the gaps.

 - Product partnership: Engage early with Product, Engineering, and Legal on new product launches, feature changes, and fund flow redesigns to ensure finance requirements (accounting, controls, reporting, regulatory) are built in from the start.

 - FX Hub and treasury infrastructure: Support the operationalization of a new FX Hub and related intercompany structures. Lead the accounting design for back-to-back hedge arrangements..

 - Systems and data quality: Maintain accountability for ledger data quality underpinning reconciliation (e.g. Oracle movement types, BAM records, Leapfin domain tagging). Drive resolution of structural data issues with Engineering and Ops counterparts.

 - Technical aptitude: A builder's mindset with genuine interest in AI and automation tools. Comfort with data concepts, SQL, or scripting is a plus. Demonstrated ability to work with Engineering and Product teams to solve finance problems through technology rather than headcount.

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Partnerships team at Airwallex is a collaborative group of dealmakers and relationship builders, passionate about forging strategic alliances that accelerate Airwallex's growth. We leverage our deep industry knowledge and financial acumen to identify and nurture win-win partnerships with leading companies, fintech innovators, and financial institutions. Together, we share a vision of unlocking opportunities for global businesses, working closely with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless integrations and maximize value for both Airwallex and our partners.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships, Americas, will play a critical role in driving business growth by identifying, developing, and managing some of the most pivotal and complex partnerships globally for Airwallex. Highly cross-functional, this role will work across key teams, including legal, product, operations, sales, marketing, and more, quarterbacking impactful strategic commercial and product integrations to accelerate Airwallex’s growth. This individual will be responsible for forming and nurturing key relationships with partners that align with the company’s business objectives, creating synergies that result in significant user adoption and revenue growth. 

This role is based in San Francisco or New York.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Translate Airwallex’s key objectives into a comprehensive partnerships and outbound strategy, identifying target partners and mutually synergistic use-cases and being able to communicate and convince effectively

 - Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, externally with executives and decision makers, and internally with cross-functional teams

 - Lead product integration scoping and structure/negotiate partnership agreement and value exchanges that are mutually beneficial, ensuring appropriate risk mitigation and securing collaborative cross-functional buy-in

 - Craft a multitude of deal types and own partner relationships across verticals, structures, and deal stages (pre-deal, implementation and post-deal partner management)




WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Bachelor’s degree

 - Minimum 5 years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, product or related roles

 - Proven track record of being able to think strategically and manage complex dynamics and motivations

 - Ability to earn trust and work effectively in a cross-cultural, global environment across teams and time-zones

 - Strong executive presence, including excellent communication and presentation skills

 - Ability to craft product integrations, think through product or commercial nuances

 - Strategic thinker with the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, and deal with significant ambiguity

 - Quantitative capacity to measure partnership ROI, understand performance metrics and optimization levers
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Prior fintech and payments experience 

 - Prior partnerships and deal making experience

jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the role

Airwallex is looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing to lead our strategic approach to third-party spend globally.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will shape category and vendor strategies, lead our most important commercial negotiations, and identify opportunities to optimize our vendor portfolio and cost base. The role spans major indirect spend categories, with particular focus on technology, software, cloud and other strategically important vendors.

This is a strategy-led, highly analytical role. We are looking for someone who can anticipate needs rather than react to procurement requests, challenge demand and requirements where appropriate, and balance cost discipline with quality, technical capability, risk and long-term strategic value. Procurement operations and transactional processes are supported separately.



What you'll do

Set category and vendor strategy

 - Develop category strategies across major areas of third-party spend, informed by business priorities, market dynamics, cost drivers and the vendor landscape.

 - Build a forward-looking view of Airwallex's vendor portfolio, identifying opportunities to consolidate, rationalize, re-source or deepen strategic relationships.

 - Shape sourcing decisions early, including requirements, vendor selection, commercial models, build-versus-buy considerations and longer-term vendor strategy.



Lead strategic sourcing and negotiations

 - Lead Airwallex's most important sourcing initiatives and vendor negotiations, from market assessment and commercial evaluation through contracting and renewal.

 - Develop rigorous negotiation strategies using benchmarks, usage and demand data, competitive alternatives, total cost of ownership and detailed vendor economics.

 - Optimize the full commercial structure, including pricing, commitments, contract duration, payment terms, renewals, price increases and service levels.



Drive value and cost discipline

 - Build and prioritize a pipeline of opportunities across pricing, demand, utilization, specifications, vendor consolidation and commercial structures.

 - Challenge whether spend is necessary and appropriately sized, rather than focusing solely on negotiating lower prices.

 - Quantify and track commercial outcomes, ensuring negotiated value translates into realized financial impact and informs budgeting and forward planning.



Build strategic sourcing capabilities

 - Establish clear frameworks and best practices for sourcing, supplier selection, negotiation, strategic vendor management and renewals.

 - Build a reliable source of truth across vendors, spend, contracts, commitments, renewals and key commercial risks.

 - Bring external benchmarks and market intelligence into decision-making, while establishing appropriate governance for Airwallex's most strategic vendors.



What we're looking for

 - 8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, category management, procurement, commercial strategy or a related field, ideally within technology, fintech or another fast-growing global business.

 - Strong track record of personally leading complex, high-value negotiations and delivering material commercial outcomes.

 - Deep experience in technology and software sourcing; exposure to cloud, data, professional services or other major indirect categories is highly desirable.

 - Strong strategic, analytical and financial capabilities, including experience evaluating pricing structures, usage, total cost of ownership and vendor economics.

 - Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance cost, capability, speed, risk and longer-term strategic value.

 - Ability to operate from strategy through execution, from developing a category roadmap to working through the detail of a complex pricing model or contract.

 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to influence senior internal stakeholders and vendor executives.

 - High ownership and comfort building structure and best practices in a fast-moving environment.

jobs.description:

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Legal, Risk & Compliance (LRC) team at Airwallex is a collaborative group of legal minds and risk management experts. We're passionate about safeguarding Airwallex's operations, fostering a culture of compliance and ethical conduct, and ensuring we navigate the global financial landscape with integrity. We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal, compliance and financial risks.

The Global Regulatory Compliance Team forms part of the second line of defence (2LOD) at Airwallex whilst operating within the larger LRC function.  We are a proactive and trusted business partner committed to enabling Airwallex’s growth and strategic goals by providing an advisory and oversight role. Our team culture is collaborative, impact-driven with a focus on continuous improvement. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, empowerment, and high performance.

This role has a specific focus on our business in Japan. This role will be a key member of the Global Regulatory Compliance Team, with a reporting line to the Director, Regulatory Compliance, Asia (based in Singapore).




WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Regulatory Compliance Manager, Japan you will deliver on the regulatory engagement strategy for Airwallex in the region and manage our existing payment services and money remittance regulatory compliance program. You will maintain our licensing responsibilities and coordinate with all internal and external parties as necessary to ensure compliance. This includes communication of regulatory requirements, cross-functional collaboration to productize solutions and offerings, implementation and execution of processes, filing of all requisite reports, renewal of registrations and licenses, and interfacing with regulators. You will analyse new and existing products and provide guidance to ensure that our 2LOD controls are fit for purpose and comply with regulatory obligations and guide the first line business to enable the maturity of both customer-facing and internal back-office processes and product features.

Responsibilities:

 - Support the Airwallex Group’s expansion by managing the regulatory compliance components of licence authorisation processes

 - Act as a key stakeholder in relation to licence applications, business plan updates and information requests between Airwallex and our regulators

 - Ensure that our regulatory compliance and integrity risk reporting obligations are maintained in Japan and support and / or manage regulatory requests

 - Advise the business with respect to regulatory change initiatives with a particular focus on how to effectively manage compliance risk attached to new laws and regulations in the jurisdictions we operate

 - Develop policies, processes and provide advice in relation to regulatory risk obligations that exist within the first line business

 - Manage regulatory compliance risk within the Airwallex Risk Management Framework and associated escalation process (inc. the Group Risk Committee)

 - Advise the business in relation to conduct risk and ethics matters (where appropriate) relating to our financial services licences

 - Deliver the Compliance Monitoring Program; Conduct targeted and thematic reviews on a wide range of topics to ensure appropriate organisational maturity

 - Deliver the Airwallex Group’s Compliance Training for employees and conduct ad-hoc training to specific business areas as required

 - Conduct ‘Proactive Special Ops’ projects to unlock business or operational issues to enable Airwallex to achieve its strategic goals more rapidly




WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 6 years of compliance experience in a regulated financial institution, FinTech, legal / consulting firm, or combination of the above

 - Familiarity with financial regulatory laws, rules, regulations and industry best practices in Japan but also more broadly across the Asia region.

 - Data proficiency - ability to work with data and leverage it for strategic decision-making

 - Ability to operate strategically and think creatively to solve complex regulatory compliance challenges

 - Superior communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to a wide range of stakeholders including regulators, executive leadership, and front-line staff

 - Experience with developing and/or maintaining a compliance program within a financial institution, preferably in respect of payments activity

 - Exposure to licensing processes, regulatory expansion, and RegTech or technology-driven compliance solutions

 - Understanding of financial products and related conduct risk, ethics, and controls

Preferred Qualification:

 - Demonstrable experience dealing with the FSA and other financial services regulators across the Asia region




AIRWALLEXについて

Airwallexは、グローバル企業向けの統合型決済・金融プラットフォームです。独自のインフラとソフトウェアを基盤に、世界250,000社以上の企業（Brex、Rippling、Navan、Qantas、SHEINなど）に対し、ビジネスアカウント、決済、支出管理、資金管理、さらには組み込み型金融（Embedded Finance）までをシームレスに提供しています。

Airwallexはオーストラリア・メルボルンで創業し、現在では世界27拠点、2,300名以上の優秀なメンバーが在籍しています。企業価値は110億米ドルを超え、T. Rowe Price、Visa、Mastercard、Sequoia Capital、Salesforce Venturesなど世界有数の投資家から支援を受けています。私たちは次世代のグローバル金融インフラを構築し、世界中の企業が国境を越えて成長できる未来を創っています。

大きな挑戦を通じてキャリアを加速させたい方をお待ちしています。




AIRWALLEXが大切にする価値観

私たちは、起業家精神を持ち、自ら課題を発見し解決できる「ビルダー」を求めています。

インパクトの大きな仕事に挑戦したい方、急速な成長環境で学び続けたい方、そして高いオーナーシップを持って成果を追求できる方が活躍できる環境です。

論理的思考力と専門性を持ちながらも、謙虚で協調性があり、ゼロからイチを生み出し、最後までやり遂げる力を重視しています。また、AIを積極的に活用し、よりスマートに課題解決できることも歓迎します。

世界中の優秀な仲間とともに、グローバル金融の未来を創りたい方のご応募をお待ちしています。




チームについて

Legal, Risk & Compliance（LRC）チームは、法務、リスク管理、コンプライアンスの専門家で構成されるグローバルチームです。Airwallexの事業運営を支え、高い倫理観とコンプライアンス文化を醸成しながら、グローバル金融業界における法的・規制上のリスクを適切に管理しています。

本ポジションが所属するGlobal Regulatory Compliance Teamは、LRC組織内における第二線防衛機能（2LOD）として、事業成長と戦略目標の達成を支援する重要な役割を担っています。規制対応におけるアドバイザリーおよび監督機能を提供し、ビジネスパートナーとして事業部門と密接に連携しています。

チームカルチャーは非常に協力的で、成果志向かつ継続的な改善を重視しています。透明性・オーナーシップ・高いパフォーマンスを大切にする環境です。

本ポジションは日本事業を担当し、シンガポール拠点のDirector, Regulatory Compliance, Asiaにレポートします。




ポジション概要

Regulatory Compliance Manager, Japanとして、日本における規制当局対応戦略の推進および決済サービス・資金移動業に関するコンプライアンスプログラムの運営を担っていただきます。

ライセンス維持や規制対応をリードし、社内外の関係者と連携しながら法令遵守を確保します。また、新規・既存プロダクトのレビューを通じて規制上の観点から助言を行い、事業部門と協力しながら顧客向けおよび社内業務プロセスの高度化を推進します。




主な業務内容

 - Airwallexグループの事業拡大を支援するため、ライセンス取得・認可プロセスにおけるコンプライアンス対応をリード

 - ライセンス申請、事業計画変更、規制当局からの情報照会等に関する主要な窓口として対応

 - 日本における規制報告義務およびコンプライアンス報告体制の維持・管理

 - コンプライアンス・モニタリング・プログラムの実施およびテーマ別レビューの実行

 - 全社向けコンプライアンス研修の企画・実施

 - ビジネス課題やオペレーション課題の解決を目的とした特別プロジェクトの推進




応募資格


必須要件

 - 学士号取得者

 - 金融機関、FinTech企業、法律事務所、コンサルティングファーム等におけるコンプライアンス関連業務経験6年以上

 - 日本の金融規制・法令に関する深い知識を有し、アジア地域の規制環境についても理解している方

As (Senior) Manager, Regulatory Compliance, New Zealand you will deliver on the regulatory engagement strategy and maintain our licensing responsibilities for our regulated financial services entity in New Zealand.  - Direct point of contact with the FMA in New Zealand

 - Deliver the regulatory engagement strategy in the region

 - Support the Airwallex Group’s expansion by managing the regulatory compliance components of any licence authorisation processes

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 기관이 보유한 회원사 또는 지원 대상 기업의 니즈를 파악하고, Airwallex를 해외 확장을 위한 실질적 솔루션으로 포지셔닝합니다.

THE ROLE

The SME & Growth sales team helps international businesses manage global financial flows, control spend and replace fragmented banking, card, expense and accounts-payable tools.

As Sales Development Manager, you will lead two outbound SDR teams covering Payment Acceptance and Spend across French SMB and Mid-Market accounts. You will build the operating rhythm, coaching culture and processes that make the teams more productive and create higher-quality pipeline.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will work directly with reps on territories, account lists, sequences, messaging, call reviews, role plays and product training. You will also make outbound calls yourself to lead by example and stay close to what works in a competitive French market.

The team’s target is for at least 60% of pipeline to be sourced from SDR activity. You will own both sides of this ambition: creating enough outbound volume while improving quality through meeting attendance, follow-up, AE acceptance, conversion and win-rate visibility on SDR-sourced deals.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead, coach and develop the Payment Acceptance and Spend SDR teams across SMB and Mid-Market.

 - Build effective territories, account lists, sequences and outbound plays by segment, persona and use case.

 - Establish clear standards for activity, qualification, meeting preparation, follow-up and handover.

 - Run regular 1:1s, call reviews, role plays, team training and individual development plans.

 - Track cold calls, conversations, meetings, no-shows, opportunities, pipeline, conversion and win rate; turn insights into practical coaching and process improvements.

 - Create and maintain simple playbooks covering outbound execution, product knowledge, qualification and competitive messaging.

 - Partner closely with Sales Managers and AEs on ICP, account ownership, meeting quality and pipeline feedback.

 - Work with Marketing, RevOps and Enablement to improve data, messaging, tooling, routing and training.

 - Regularly join call blocks and demonstrate strong cold calling, objection handling and follow-up.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 4+ years of B2B sales experience, including meaningful experience managing or leading SDR/BDR teams.

 - Experience running outbound motions across SMB and Mid-Market accounts.

 - Strong personal cold-calling and multi-channel prospecting experience.

 - A track record of coaching reps and improving individual and team performance.

 - Experience building or standardising territories, sequences, qualification processes or sales playbooks.

 - Confidence discussing activity volume, meetings, pipeline, conversion and win rate.

 - Experience in a high-volume but non-transactional environment, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, ERP, procurement or spend management.

 - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work with SDRs, AEs, Sales Managers, Marketing and RevOps.

 - Fluent French and professional English.

 - A hands-on, data-driven and high-ownership approach to management.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You build two well-coached, consistently executing SDR teams that generate meaningful outbound impact for both Payment Acceptance and Spend.

Success means:

 - At least 60% of pipeline is sourced from SDR activity.

 - Outbound volume is consistent, while meeting quality and relevance improve.

 - No-shows are actively managed and meeting-to-opportunity conversion improves.

 - SDR-sourced pipeline has clear AE acceptance, follow-up and win-rate visibility.

 - Reps receive regular coaching, product training and clear development plans.

 - Territories, sequences, qualification standards and playbooks are documented and adopted.

 - Sales Managers and SDRs operate with a shared view of ICP, quality and performance.


WHY JOIN AIRWALLEX

You will have direct ownership of a strategic French growth engine and the opportunity to shape how outbound is built across Payment Acceptance and Spend.

You will work with an ambitious international team across Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Product and Enablement, with the autonomy to test ideas, learn quickly and create visible impact.

 - Commercial role focused on the strategic French market.

 - Hybrid role: minimum three days per week in our Paris office.

 - Competitive salary, commission and equity.

 - Define and refine our ideal customer profiles, use cases, and value propositions across eCommerce, software/tech, trading, import & export, and manufacturing.

jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the team
The SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers.



What you'll do

The GTM Partnerships team at Airwallex drives new customer acquisition through strategic partners and builds scalable partnership models that convert ecosystem relationships into meaningful business outcomes.

This role focuses on corporate secretarial firms, law firms, accounting firms, tax advisors, and related professional service partners. The role requires both relationship depth and commercial discipline: strengthening and broadening existing SOWs, onboarding new strategic partners, and building proactive win strategies informed by competitive intelligence.


Responsibilities:

 - Build and strengthen long-term partnerships with corporate secretarial, legal, accounting, tax, and related professional service firms.

 - Protect and grow existing SOWs by creating stronger collaboration structures, deeper engagement plans, and clearer commercial value for partners.

 - Identify and onboard new strategic partners that are not yet working with Airwallex, with a focus on early-stage customer lock-in and durable relationship building.

 - Monitor competitor activity and use market intelligence to develop practical strategies that improve Airwallex’s win rate with partners and end customers.

 - Work closely with partners that support company formation, overseas expansion, FX-related operations, and compliance-heavy customer journeys.

 - Help partners position Airwallex more effectively against alternatives through structured messaging, training, and joint account strategies.

 - Collaborate with internal teams to defend strategic accounts, expand partner-led revenue, and improve execution quality.


Who you are
Requirements:

 - Someone with strong experience managing large or strategically important partners in corporate services, legal, tax, or advisory ecosystems.

 - Someone who can maintain executive-level partner relationships while also driving day-to-day commercial execution.

 - Someone who can use competitor intelligence to shape persuasive partner strategies and defend or expand Airwallex’s position.

 - Someone who understands how to lock in early customer relationships through trusted intermediary partners.

 - Someone who is commercially sharp, structured, and comfortable operating in competitive partnership environments.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience working with competitors or adjacent solutions such as Aspire, Stripe, Payoneer, or Mercury.

 - Experience related to foreign exchange operations, overseas entity setup, or global business structuring.

 - Experience managing partnerships where partner influence plays a major role in customer onboarding and solution selection.

 - Experience expanding the scope of existing SOWs or growing partner-led revenue within strategic accounts..

What success looks like:

Success in this role means strengthening strategic partner relationships while increasing partner-led influence, customer lock-in, and commercial outcomes.

 - Deepen existing strategic partnerships and expand the scope of SOWs over time.

 - Onboard new high-value partners and establish early customer lock-in through strong partner collaboration.

 - Use competitive intelligence to build stronger win strategies and improve partner confidence in positioning Airwallex.

 - Improve partner-led revenue contribution through disciplined relationship management and execution.

Application tips:

Strong applications should clearly demonstrate:

 - Which corporate services, legal, tax, or accounting partners you managed.

 - Whether you expanded existing SOWs, deepened partner relationships, or strengthened strategic partner influence.

 - How you responded to competitor activity and turned intelligence into a practical win strategy.

 - Whether you have experience related to FX, overseas entity setup, or complex cross-border customer journeys.




국문 버전


ABOUT THE TEAM

Airwallex의 GTM Partnerships 팀은 전략적 파트너와의 협업을 통해 신규 고객 유입을 만들고, 파트너십을 실제 사업 성과로 연결하는 구조를 설계하고 운영합니다.

이 역할은 CorpSec, 로펌, 회계법인, 세무·자문사 등 전문 서비스 파트너와의 전략적 협업에 초점을 둡니다. 기존 대형 파트너사와의 SOW를 유지·확대하는 동시에, 아직 확보되지 않은 신규 전략 파트너를 온보딩하고, 경쟁사 인텔리전스를 기반으로 우리가 이길 수 있는 방법을 적극적으로 설계하는 역할이 중요합니다.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - 기존 SOW를 안정적으로 운영하면서, 협업 구조를 고도화하고 업무 범위를 확장합니다.

 - 아직 협업하지 않고 있는 신규 전략 파트너를 발굴하고 온보딩하며, 초기 고객사 락인을 포함한 관계 기반 영업 구조를 만듭니다.

 - 경쟁사 활동과 시장 인텔리전스를 지속적으로 파악하고, 파트너 및 최종 고객 관점에서 Airwallex의 승률을 높일 수 있는 실행 전략을 설계합니다.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 시니어 레벨의 파트너 관계를 유지하면서도 실제 사업 실행까지 챙길 수 있는 분

 - 경쟁사 인텔리전스를 활용해 파트너 전략을 고도화하고, 방어 및 확장 시나리오를 설계할 수 있는 분

 - 경쟁적인 파트너 환경에서도 구조적으로 실행할 수 있는 사업 감각이 있는 분


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 외환 관련 업무, 해외 법인 설립, 글로벌 비즈니스 구조 설계 관련 경험

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

이 역할의 성공은 전략 파트너의 추천 영향력을 높이고, 초기 고객 락인을 강화해, 실질적인 사업 성과를 확대하는 것입니다.

We work closely with regional commercial teams and cross-functional partners across Marketing, Strategy, and Operations to identify where partnerships can accelerate growth, unlock new audiences, and create repeatable go-to-market advantage.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We are looking for a  Startup and VC Ecosystem Partnerships Manager, DACH to build and scale Airwallex’s venture capital and startup ecosystem motion across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, with an initial focus on Germany as our priority growth market in the region.

Based in Berlin, you will lead the local VC and startup ecosystem strategy across partnership development, portfolio activation, founder community engagement, and market-facing programmes, acting as the in-market owner who connects ecosystem relationships with pipeline generation and commercial execution.

You will work closely with DACH sales leadership, the CPM Director, and cross-functional GTM teams to turn our startup and VC go-to-market priorities into measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.

This is a highly cross-functional role for a hands-on operator who can build from the ground up.

You will own high-impact regional initiatives such as VC partnership development, founder and portfolio programmes, community events, ecosystem campaigns, and market-facing engagement, while ensuring strong alignment with sales and clear commercial follow-through.

This role is based in our Berlin office, with a requirement to work from the office three days per week.

We do not offer remote contracts for this position.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and execute the DACH VC and startup ecosystem strategy, with a particular focus on accelerating pipeline and revenue growth in Germany.

 - Own the planning and execution of regional ecosystem programmes across venture capital partnerships, accelerators, founder communities, portfolio activation, and local market development initiatives.

 - Lead the end-to-end development of VC and startup partnerships in DACH, including sourcing, relationship-building, onboarding, joint planning, and activation, ensuring clear commercial goals and measurable pipeline impact.

 - Develop and strengthen relationships with key local ecosystems, including investors, platform teams, accelerators, incubators, founder communities, and strategic networks that matter in the DACH market.

 - Drive joint go-to-market initiatives with VC partners and ecosystem stakeholders, creating co-branded programmes, events, and referral plays that generate awareness, credibility, and opportunities.

 - Partner with regional sales and business leaders to translate commercial priorities into focused ecosystem plans, account support, and market-level growth plays for startup and scale-up audiences.

 - Work closely with Marketing, Strategy, and broader GTM teams to adapt and localise ecosystem programmes for DACH audiences, with a strong focus on founder, finance, and operator communities.

 - Lead the creation and localisation of German-language and region-specific ecosystem content, including partner messaging, founder-facing materials, event narratives, and other in-market assets where relevant.

 - Own the regional ecosystem lead journey from referral or engagement through handoff, ensuring tight coordination with sales and strong follow-up processes that maximise conversion from partnership activity.

 - Track, analyse, and communicate performance across partner and ecosystem channels, turning insights into clear recommendations and continuous optimisation.

 - Act as the voice of the DACH startup and VC ecosystem within the wider organisation, bringing local partner, founder, and competitive insight into regional and global planning.

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role.

The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

 - Significant experience in partnerships, ecosystem development, business development, startup programmes, or related commercial roles in high-growth technology, fintech, SaaS, or adjacent sectors.

 - Direct experience working in or closely with the startup ecosystem, for example at a startup, scale-up, venture capital firm, accelerator, incubator, founder platform, or another ecosystem-led organisation.

 - Demonstrated success building and executing partnership or ecosystem plans that drive pipeline and commercial outcomes, particularly across venture capital, startup, or community-led motions.

 - Strong experience developing relationships and programmes that create measurable commercial outcomes, not just brand visibility.

 - Proven ability to work closely with sales and commercial teams to develop joint plans, align on targets, and deliver shared outcomes.

 - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret channel and funnel performance, build clear narratives from data, and make data-driven decisions.

 - Excellent project ownership and execution skills, with the ability to operate as a self-starter in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German language capability is a strong advantage for market-facing work in DACH.

 - Ability to work from our Berlin office three days per week.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or scaling a regional ecosystem, partnerships, or startup motion, or serving as an early in-market hire in a new or rapidly growing region.

Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the Team

The Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team at Airwallex is a strategically vital function operating under a clear Three Lines of Defense model. As the independent second line, FCC owns the global AML/CTF program, sanctions framework, risk assessment methodology, and governance infrastructure across all global entities. As Airwallex scales into new markets and deepens its engagement with global regulatory bodies, we are building a world-class compliance organization capable of managing complex financial crime risks at scale. This is an environment where you will tackle high-impact challenges, shape global fintech risk strategies, and help establish foundations for long-term growth.



The Role

Airwallex is establishing a Spanish Branch Office of Airwallex Netherlands B.V. ("Airwallex NL"), its Dutch-licensed e-money institution regulated by De Nederlandsche Bank ("DNB"), to support its go-to-market strategy in Spain and the broader Southern European region.

As Manager, Financial Crime Compliance & the Money Laundering Reporting Officer ("MLRO") for the Spanish Branch Office, you will be responsible for supporting the launch and ongoing compliance maintenance of the Branch Office from a financial crime, regulatory and governance perspective. You will ensure that the Spanish Branch Office operates in accordance with applicable Spanish AML/CTF requirements under Ley 10/2010 de Prevención del Blanqueo de Capitales y de la Financiación del Terrorismo ("Ley 10/2010") and its implementing regulation Real Decreto 304/2014 ("RD 304/2014"), SEPBLAC expectations and reporting requirements, applicable EU AML/CTF and sanctions frameworks, and Airwallex NL's global and regional FCC standards.

You will act as the designated Representante ante el SEPBLAC and local FCC lead for Airwallex's Spanish Branch Office, serving as a key point of contact for SEPBLAC, Banco de España, law enforcement agencies, and other relevant Spanish and EU authorities.

In addition, you will work cross-functionally with Product, Commercial, Operations, Data, and Legal colleagues to ensure our controls effectively prevent, detect, and report financial crime while enabling sustainable growth in the Spanish and Southern European markets.



Responsibilities

Regulatory Leadership & SEPBLAC Liaison

 - Serve as the designated MLRO and Representante ante el SEPBLAC for the Airwallex Spanish Branch, fulfilling local AML/CTF obligations under Ley 10/2010 and RD 304/2014, as applicable to a branch of a DNB-supervised institution operating in Spain.

 - Act as the primary local contact for SEPBLAC and Banco de España in respect of branch-level supervisory matters, regulatory notifications, and any correspondence or inspections relating to the Spanish Branch.

 - Support the EMEA Regulatory and Compliance team in managing the Spanish branch notification and approval process with the relevant Spanish authorities, and maintain ongoing compliance with any conditions or requirements attached to branch authorisation.

Local Compliance Oversight

 - Maintain ongoing FCC oversight of the Spanish Branch Office, ensuring that local activities remain within the approved branch perimeter and aligned to Airwallex NL's regulatory permissions.

 - Provide local compliance advice on Spain-based sales, marketing, and account management activity, ensuring that commercial activity is appropriately controlled and consistent with the Spanish Branch Office model.

 - Ensure that Spanish-specific AML/CTF and sanctions requirements under Ley 10/2010 and RD 304/2014 are appropriately reflected in local policies, procedures, escalation routes, training, governance, and reporting.

 - Commission or facilitate the periodic external expert review of the branch's AML programme required under Article 28 of RD 304/2014, and oversee remediation of any findings.

Suspicious Activity Reporting & SEPBLAC Engagement

 - Oversee local processes for identifying, escalating, assessing, and, where required, reporting suspicious activity (comunicaciones de operaciones sospechosas) to SEPBLAC via its secure reporting platform, in accordance with Articles 18–19 of Ley 10/2010.

 - Work closely with the EMEA FCC team to ensure that Spain-related suspicious activity is identified, investigated, escalated, and documented appropriately, in compliance with the tipping-off prohibition under Article 24 of Ley 10/2010.

 - Provide MLRO review and decision-making input on Spain-related suspicious activity, customer exits, account restrictions, law enforcement requests, and other financial crime risk outcomes where local Spanish input is required.

Commercial Enablement & Risk Advisory

 - Serve as the embedded compliance partner for the Spanish commercial and sales team, providing day-to-day regulatory guidance on customer queries, product use cases, and market-specific risk scenarios relevant to the Spanish and Southern European market.

 - Advise on Spanish market-specific compliance considerations for complex client engagements, ensuring appropriate escalation to the EMEA FCC and KYC Ops teams where required.

 - Support the assessment and launch of new products or commercial initiatives targeting the Spanish market, ensuring controls are proportionate and consistent with SEPBLAC expectations and Airwallex NL's risk appetite.

Governance & Reporting

 - Provide regular compliance MI and reporting to Airwallex NL senior management and relevant Group Risk Committees, covering branch-level risk indicators, regulatory developments, and the effectiveness of local controls.

 - Maintain and update the branch's formal risk assessment under RD 304/2014, ensuring it reflects the current risk profile of the Spanish Branch and is reviewed at least annually.

 - Fulfil any local reporting obligations to SEPBLAC or Banco de España arising from the branch's regulatory status, in coordination with Airwallex NL's Compliance and Legal teams.

Audit & Remediation

 - Support the response to SEPBLAC and Banco de España branch-level supervisory enquiries, internal audits, and independent AML reviews, coordinating with the Internal Audit function where necessary.

 - Drive timely identification and remediation of any local compliance deficiencies, maintaining robust evidence of actions taken.

Who You Are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.



Minimum Qualifications

 - Education: Bachelor's Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field is preferred.

 - Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial crime compliance with experience as an MLRO or Representante ante el SEPBLAC within a regulated financial institution, payment institution, or fintech operating in Spain or the broader EU/EEA market.

 - Regulatory Knowledge: Sound knowledge of Spanish AML/CTF obligations under Ley 10/2010 and RD 304/2014, the role of SEPBLAC as Spain's FIU and supervisory authority, the Órgano de Control Interno (OCI) framework, and Banco de España's oversight of payment institutions; familiarity with how EU AML Directives (AMLD4/AMLD5/AMLD6) and the forthcoming EU AML Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 apply in Spain.

 - Regulatory Exposure: Prior experience interacting with SEPBLAC and/or Banco de España, whether in a direct or supporting capacity (e.g., branch notifications, STR filings, regulatory correspondence, supervisory inspections).

 - Operational Judgement: Demonstrated ability to manage suspicious activity escalations, STR filings via SEPBLAC's secure reporting platform, and to make sound, timely compliance decisions in a fast-paced commercial environment.

 - Stakeholder Management: Ability to credibly engage internal stakeholders across compliance, legal, and commercial functions, and to represent Airwallex professionally before Spanish regulatory authorities.

 - Language: Business-level proficiency in both Spanish and English is required; the ability to conduct regulatory correspondence and draft compliance documentation in Spanish is essential.
   
   

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience supporting a branch office or cross-border operation of a foreign-licensed financial institution or e-money institution in Spain, with an understanding of the DNB/SEPBLAC and DNB/Banco de España supervisory interface.

 - Experience in payments, fintech, or e-commerce, supporting cross-border products, card issuing/acquiring, or embedded finance use cases in the Spanish and/or EU market

 - Recognised professional certification in compliance or financial crime (e.g., CAMS, ICA Diploma, or CGSS).

 - Experience operating within a regional or global FCC function and partnering across multiple jurisdictions and time zones — particularly within the EU/EEA regulatory framework.

 - Prior exposure to EU and UN sanctions compliance frameworks and their application in a Spanish commercial context.

 - Familiarity with SEPBLAC's published sectoral guidance documents, typologies, and risk indicators, and their practical application within a payments/fintech business model.

 - Strong ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across commercial and compliance functions, balancing business enablement with regulatory rigour.

The team is passionate about operational excellence and delivering an exceptional end-to-end customer experience.

You will ensure that Airwallex champions high standards for integrity, judgement and documentation in all aspects of risk operations.



Responsibilities:

 - Own the vision, strategy and execution for Risk Operations

 - Build, lead and develop high-performing a globally distributed team

 - Own the location and resourcing strategy of the team, solving for 24/7 coverage, quality of customer experience and cost efficiency

 - Create a repeatable & scalable operating rhythm, including clear OKRs

 - Take a data-driven approach to performance management

 - Strike the right balance between risk, customer experience and commercial impact, ensuring timely, high-quality decision making and communications

 - Drive continuous improvement in the quality of procedures, playbooks and control frameworks, aligned to Airwallex financial crime and fraud policies defined by 2LOD and partnering closely with Risk Product and Engineering

 - Ensure that Airwallex continues to improve the quality and consistency of documentation

 - Lead AI transformation of the Risk Operations team

This role will be based in either London or Singapore.



Who are you:

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.



Minimum qualifications:

 - Proven experience, including senior leadership in large-scale, multi-jurisdiction operations in a rapidly growing regulated financial-services or payments/fintech business

 - Proven track record of scaling Risk Operations (at least 2 of Payments, Issuing and Credit) across multiple geographies, and of building globally consistent performance

 - Background in Fraud Ops and ATO risk control

 - Strong commercial and analytical judgement — comfortable framing decisions in unit economics, scalability and return on investment

 - Track record of operating at the Operations–Product–Risk intersection and driving cross-functional outcomes without full reporting-line authority

 - Demonstrated delivery of automation/AI-led transformation in an operations setting

 - Evidence of big data/analytics (including SQL, DBX and BI tooling)



Preferred experience:

 - Cross-border payments; multi-entity, multi-licence environments

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Manager & MLRO, Japan
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Legal, Risk & Compliance (LRC) team at Airwallex is a collaborative group of legal minds and risk management experts. We're passionate about safeguarding Airwallex's operations, fostering a culture of compliance and ethical conduct, and ensuring we navigate the global financial landscape with integrity. We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal and financial risks.


What you’ll do

Airwallex's (Senior) Compliance Manager, Money Laundering Reporting Officer, is a key member of our global compliance team, responsible for driving and embedding Airwallex’s compliance program. This role partners with internal teams to design, develop, implement and monitor screening and monitoring rules, and supports regulatory obligations for the Japan market. Reporting to the Regional Director of Financial Crime Compliance for Asia and MLRO, this role drives the development, launch, and management of key compliance programs.

This role is based in Japan.


Responsibilities:

 - Own and develop the FCC compliance framework of Airwallex in Japan, building on the Airwallex global compliance framework

 - Manage and set departmental and individual targets for the FCC Team

 - Provide day-to-day management and execution of Airwallex’s AML regulatory interactions, examinations, and ad-hoc requests

 - Represent Airwallex with critical external stakeholders, including regulators and financial partners

 - Responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of an effective tactical, strategic, and updated anti-money laundering program

 - Manage the day-to-day BAU tasks including enhanced due diligence (EDD) approvals, name screening alert escalations, and with filing Suspicious Matter Reports as necessary

 - Provide advice and support to the Commercial and Operations team on various compliance matters

 - Work closely with the Financial Partnership team to deal with any potential enquiries from external parties including banking partners and scheme partners

 - Develop and manage a regular monitoring and reporting process to inform senior management, the audit committee and the board as necessary and required

 - Design and execute reports to measure success and performance of AML Compliance initiatives, operations, critical metrics, and Key Risk Indicators

 - Coordinate with various stakeholders to address issues raised in internal audit reports, self-assessments, compliance reviews, or regulatory examination

 - Drive internal controls design and monitoring to support Compliance Operational policy and procedures


Who you are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

 - A minimum of 8 years financial crimes compliance experience in a financial institution.

 - Ability to multitask effortlessly and handle challenging priorities under deadlines

 - Credible stakeholder engagement and management skills to align with our organisational values and behaviors

 - Written and verbal fluency in both Japanese and English

Preferred qualifications:

 - Understanding and knowledge in payment industry

 - Experience as MLRO / Deputy MLRO

 - Experience interacting with the Regulator

 - Auditing background preferred

 


AIRWALLEXについて

Airwallexは、グローバル企業向けの統合型決済・金融プラットフォームです。独自のインフラとソフトウェアを基盤に、世界250,000社以上の企業（Brex、Rippling、Navan、Qantas、SHEINなど）に対し、ビジネスアカウント、決済、支出管理、資金管理、さらには組み込み型金融（Embedded Finance）までをシームレスに提供しています。

Airwallexはオーストラリア・メルボルンで創業し、現在では世界27拠点、2,300名以上の優秀なメンバーが在籍しています。企業価値は110億米ドルを超え、T. Rowe Price、Visa、Mastercard、Sequoia Capital、Salesforce Venturesなど世界有数の投資家から支援を受けています。私たちは次世代のグローバル金融インフラを構築し、世界中の企業が国境を越えて成長できる未来を創っています。

大きな挑戦を通じてキャリアを加速させたい方をお待ちしています。

 


AIRWALLEXが大切にする価値観

私たちは、起業家精神を持ち、自ら課題を発見し解決できる「ビルダー」を求めています。

インパクトの大きな仕事に挑戦したい方、急速な成長環境で学び続けたい方、そして高いオーナーシップを持って成果を追求できる方が活躍できる環境です。

論理的思考力と専門性を持ちながらも、謙虚で協調性があり、ゼロからイチを生み出し、最後までやり遂げる力を重視しています。また、AIを積極的に活用し、よりスマートに課題解決できることも歓迎します。

世界中の優秀な仲間とともに、グローバル金融の未来を創りたい方のご応募をお待ちしています。




チームについて

AirwallexのLegal, Risk & Compliance（LRC）チームは、法務・リスク管理・コンプライアンス領域の専門家で構成されるグローバルチームです。

私たちは、Airwallexの事業運営を保護し、コンプライアンスと高い倫理観を企業文化として推進するとともに、グローバルな金融環境において健全かつ持続的な成長を実現することをミッションとしています。

各ビジネスチームに対して専門的なガイダンスとサポートを提供し、法務・規制・金融リスクを事前に特定、評価、管理することで、事業成長を支える重要な役割を担っています。




ポジション概要

(Senior) Compliance Manager, Money Laundering Reporting Officer（MLRO）は、Airwallexのグローバルコンプライアンスチームにおける重要なポジションです。

本ポジションでは、日本市場における金融犯罪コンプライアンス（Financial Crime Compliance / FCC）プログラムの構築・運営・高度化をリードしていただきます。

社内各チームと連携しながら、顧客スクリーニングやモニタリングルールの設計・導入・改善を推進するとともに、日本におけるAML（マネーロンダリング対策）関連の規制要件への対応を担っていただきます。

Asia Regional Director, Financial Crime Compliance & MLROへレポートし、日本市場における主要なコンプライアンスプログラムの企画、導入、運営を推進する役割です。

本ポジションは日本勤務となります。




主な業務内容

 - Airwallexグローバルコンプライアンスフレームワークを基盤に、日本市場における金融犯罪コンプライアンス（FCC）体制の構築・運営・改善をリードする

 - FCCチームの目標設定、業務管理、チームメンバーの育成を行う

 - AML関連の規制当局対応、検査対応、各種問い合わせ対応を日常的に管理・推進する

 - 規制当局、金融機関、決済パートナーなど重要な外部ステークホルダーとの関係構築および対応窓口を担う

 - 効果的かつ最新のAMLプログラムの設計、導入、維持管理を行う

 - EDD（Enhanced Due Diligence）の承認、ネームスクリーニングアラート対応、必要に応じた疑わしい取引報告等の日常業務を管理する

 - CommercialチームおよびOperationsチームに対して、コンプライアンス関連の助言・サポートを提供する

 - Financial Partnershipチームと連携し、銀行パートナーや決済ネットワーク等の外部パートナーからの問い合わせ対応を行う

 - シニアマネジメント、監査委員会、取締役会向けの定期的なモニタリング・レポーティング体制を構築・管理する

 - AMLコンプライアンス施策、業務パフォーマンス、主要指標（KPI/KRI）を測定するためのレポートを設計・実行する

 - 内部監査、セルフアセスメント、コンプライアンスレビュー、規制当局検査等で特定された課題について、関連チームと連携して対応を推進する

 - コンプライアンス業務プロセスおよび内部統制の設計・モニタリングを推進する


応募資格


必須要件

 - 金融機関、FinTech企業、決済事業者等における金融犯罪コンプライアンス（FCC）またはAML領域での8年以上の実務経験

 - 複数の優先事項を管理し、期限のある複雑な課題にも柔軟に対応できる能力

 - 社内外のステークホルダーと効果的に連携できる高いコミュニケーション能力および調整力

 - 日本語（ネイティブレベル）および英語（ビジネスレベル）の読み書き・会話能力


歓迎要件

 - 決済業界、電子決済サービス、FinTech業界に関する知識・経験

 - MLROまたはDeputy MLROとしての経験

 - 金融庁（FSA）など規制当局との対応経験

 - 内部監査または監査関連業務の経験


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

ABOUT THE TEAM

The People & Talent team at Airwallex is dedicated to attracting, developing, and enabling the brightest and most ambitious minds to drive our company forward. We are a global, vibrant, and dynamic team focused on creating a positive, inclusive, and high-performing environment where our people can grow and do their best work.

 

Through thoughtful People & Talent programmes, scalable processes, and a deep understanding of our organisation’s needs, we build a collaborative and engaging employee experience that supports Airwallex’s continued growth and success.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

This role sits at the intersection of People Operations and Workplace Experience for our Paris/Berlin/Barcelona office. You will act as a critical “boots on the ground” partner, ensuring core HR operations for the EMEA team run smoothly while helping build a strong, engaging in-office culture during a period of rapid growth for EMEA.

 

You’ll own high-volume, detail-oriented work (onboarding, offboarding, payroll inputs, benefits) while also identifying opportunities to improve and automate processes as we scale. As part of the EMEA team, you will help with our build-out as well as opportunities to contribute to broader EMEA people operations work supporting the Region.

This is hybrid based in Berlin ( 4 days a week)

 

Responsibilities:

 - Own onboarding and offboarding end-to-end, ensuring a seamless employee experience

 - Serve as the primary POC for HR inquiries; manage ticketing system with timely, high-quality responses

 - Maintain accurate HRIS and payroll data (incl. EOR), run audits, and manage data changes

 - Support payroll processes, including commissions and bonuses by auditing inputs and resolving discrepancies

 - Administer benefits programs and support ongoing rollout; ensure compliance with the relevant regulations for the markets that you are supporting.

 - You will oversee day-to-day office operations (supplies, vendors, access, equipment, general upkeep)

 - Act as a front-of-house presence: greet visitors, manage deliveries, coordinate with building management

 - Support and execute employee engagement initiatives (events, monthly celebrations, quarterly offsites)

THE ROLE

The Accounting Partnerships team helps Airwallex reach ambitious SMEs through the firms and technology providers they already trust: accounting firms, experts-comptables, ERP and accounting-software partners, resellers, integrators and outsourced CFO/advisory firms.

As Accounting Partnerships Manager, France, you will build and grow a partner-led acquisition channel for the French market. You will identify the right partner segments, create trusted relationships, activate partners and turn those relationships into qualified introductions and pipeline for Airwallex.

This is a hands-on commercial role. You will personally source and develop partners, create the partner value proposition, test referral and co-selling motions, enable partners and work closely with Sales to convert partner-sourced opportunities. You will also build the simple operating rhythm needed to scale what works.

The role is focused on lead generation and partner activation, not technical integrations. You do not need to build APIs, but you must be able to understand customer problems, explain Airwallex’s value clearly and work with Product, Sales and Marketing when a partner or customer need requires support.

The role is based in Paris, with a minimum of three days per week working from our office.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and own the French accounting-partner strategy, aligned with the SME & Growth GTM.

 - Define and prioritise the partner ICP across accounting firms, ERP/accounting-software vendors, resellers, integrators and outsourced CFO/advisory firms.

 - Build a target list, map decision-makers and source new partners through outbound, warm introductions, events and existing relationships.

 - Recruit, qualify and activate partners based on client fit, influence, willingness to recommend and ability to generate opportunities.

 - Create simple referral, co-selling, client-introduction and co-marketing motions that produce qualified leads.

 - Build partner messaging and enablement materials that explain Airwallex’s value to both the partner and their clients.

 - Work with Sales Managers and AEs on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and feedback on partner-sourced opportunities.

 - Track partner conversations, active partners, referrals, opportunities, pipeline, conversion, time to first referral and partner-sourced revenue.

 - Separate partner-sourced from partner-influenced performance and maintain accurate CRM attribution.

 - Test new partner segments, messages and activation plays; double down on what creates quality pipeline and stop what does not.

 - Work cross-functionally with Marketing, RevOps, Product, Solutions, Risk and Compliance to remove friction from the partner journey.

 - Represent Airwallex at relevant accounting, finance, SME and technology events, webinars and partner meetings.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 2+ years of direct experience in partnerships, channel, alliances, ecosystem, partner sales or indirect business development. This must include personal ownership of external partner relationships.

 - Demonstrable experience recruiting, onboarding, activating or growing partners. “Worked with partners” without clear ownership is not sufficient.

 - Evidence of partner-generated referrals, qualified opportunities, pipeline or revenue, with the ability to explain your personal contribution and the numbers involved.

 - Existing relationships in the French accounting and finance ecosystem, including accounting firms, experts-comptables, ERP/accounting-software partners, resellers, integrators or outsourced CFO/advisory firms.

jobs.title: Head of Growth Data Science
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

Airwallex is seeking a Head of Growth Data Science to lead the team responsible for using data, experimentation, and advanced analytics to accelerate global growth.

The Growth Data Science team partners closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and regional business leaders to identify growth opportunities across the customer lifecycle—from acquisition and activation to conversion, retention, and expansion. You will help define our growth strategy, build scalable measurement frameworks, and develop the models and insights that guide investment across markets and products.



This is a full-time role based in San Francisco.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Act as a strategic data partner to senior leaders across Growth, Product, Marketing, Sales, and regional businesses.

 - Translate complex analyses into clear recommendations that shape business strategy and investment decisions.

 - Establish a consistent, trusted framework for measuring growth performance across markets, channels, and customer segments.

 - Lead analytical efforts across the growth funnel, including acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion.

 - Identify opportunities to improve channel efficiency, customer journeys, pricing, and go-to-market performance.

 - Develop segmentation, propensity, attribution, and optimization models to inform growth initiatives.

 - Build and scale experimentation frameworks to measure the impact of product, marketing, and commercial initiatives.

 - Lead the application of causal inference techniques to distinguish correlation from true incremental impact.

 - Establish best practices for experiment design, measurement, interpretation, and decision-making.

 - Own forecasting and planning models that support growth targets, resource allocation, and business reviews.

 - Develop metrics, dashboards, and analytical tools that provide timely visibility into growth performance.

 - Partner with Finance and business leaders to connect operating drivers with financial outcomes.

 - Define the roadmap for applying machine learning and Generative AI to growth analytics and decision-making.

 - Build intelligent tools that automate insight generation, improve targeting, and enhance operational efficiency.

 - Partner with engineering and data platform teams to productionize models and analytical products.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Growth-oriented leader: You have 10+ years of experience in data science, analytics, applied machine learning, or quantitative strategy, including 5+ years leading high-performing teams.

 - Strong technical foundation: You have deep expertise in experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, applied machine learning, SQL, and Python or R.

 - Strategic operator: You are comfortable prioritizing ambiguous problems, balancing trade-offs, and focusing teams on initiatives with measurable growth impact.

 - Hands-on builder: You can engage deeply with technical work while building scalable systems, analytical frameworks, and team practices.

 - Executive influencer: You communicate complex findings clearly and can influence senior stakeholders through rigorous analysis and practical recommendations.

 - Customer-centric thinker: You are passionate about understanding customer behavior and using data to create better experiences and stronger business outcomes.
   
   


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 10+ years of experience in data science, analytics, quantitative strategy, or applied machine learning.

 - At least 5 years of experience managing and developing high-performing technical teams.

 - Demonstrated experience partnering with executive and senior business leaders to influence growth strategy.

 - Hands-on experience with experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, or machine learning in a production environment.

 - Strong proficiency in SQL and Python or R.

 - Experience working with modern data platforms and tooling, such as Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or equivalent.

 - Proven ability to translate analytical insights into measurable business outcomes.

 - Experience productionizing Generative AI applications, intelligent analytics tools, or agentic workflows.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Advanced degree in Econometrics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.

 - Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or high-growth B2B SaaS.

 - Experience leading data science teams across multiple growth functions, markets, or product lines.

 - Experience with customer lifecycle analytics, marketing measurement, attribution, pricing, or sales optimization.

 - Familiarity with global payments, cross-border commerce, and regional differences in customer and market behavior.

 - Experience building data products or decision systems used by senior executives and cross-functional teams.
